title: Everything to Remember Before Invincible S3 Drops
subtitle: A quick refresher on Viltrumite politics, Mark's upgraded suit, and where the Guardians left off.

sections.heading: Mark's New Suit & Mental State
sections.content: Following the traumatic battle with Angstrom Levy, Mark is left emotionally fractured. Season 3 sees him adopt the iconic blue-and-black suit, signaling a darker, more pragmatic approach to protecting Earth.

sections.heading: The Viltrumite Threat Escalates
sections.content: Anissa's warning made it clear: Earth is running out of time. Nolan (Omni-Man) and Allen the Alien are currently forming a coalition in space, laying the groundwork for the inevitable Viltrumite War.

sections.heading: Guardians of the Globe Status
sections.content: With Rex Splode recovering from critical injuries, Cecil's manipulation of the team reaching an all-time high, and Eve struggling with her power limits, the Guardians are at their weakest.

title: DC's Absolute Universe Explained for Casuals
subtitle: How the Absolute line differs from Prime Earth, key character redesigns, and where to start.

sections.heading: What is the Absolute Universe?
sections.content: Born out of Darkseid's influence, the Absolute Universe is an alternate continuity where DC heroes lack their traditional safety nets. Superman has no Kent family farm, Wonder Woman was raised in Hell, and Batman has no fortune.

sections.heading: Absolute Batman's Key Differences
sections.content: Bruce Wayne is a blue-collar city engineer instead of a billionaire playboy. His suit is modular tactical armor built from structural steel, and his massive battle-axe emblem doubles as a heavy demolition tool.

sections.heading: Reading Order Recommendation
sections.content: Start directly with Absolute Power #4 for the universe's birth, followed by Absolute Batman #1, Absolute Superman #1, and Absolute Wonder Woman #1.

title: Chainsaw Man Part 2: Devil Contracts & Lore Refresher
subtitle: Asa Mitaka, Yoru the War Devil, and the Academy Saga's major factions.

sections.heading: Asa Mitaka & Yoru's Host Dynamics
sections.content: Unlike Denji, Asa shares her brain with the War Devil. Yoru can transform anything Asa feels ownership or guilt over into lethal weaponry.

sections.heading: The Chainsaw Man Church
sections.content: Fami (the Famine Devil) has manipulated public perception, creating a worldwide cult around Chainsaw Man to trigger widespread fear and empower the Horsemen.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen: Cursed Energy & Domain Expansion Breakdown
subtitle: Understanding negative emotions, innate techniques, binding vows, and domain mechanics.

sections.heading: Cursed Energy vs. Cursed Technique
sections.content: Cursed energy is raw electricity generated by negative human emotion. A Cursed Technique is the specific appliance that runs on that electricity (e.g., Gojo's Limitless or Megumi's Ten Shadows).

sections.heading: Domain Expansion Mechanics
sections.content: By constructing a barrier with cursed energy and manifesting their innate domain, sorcerers gain a guaranteed-hit factor for their techniques within that space.
